# Access & approvals

You control who reads your profile. The flow:

1. A customer submits a request from your public trust page (or via MCP `request_access`).
2. You see it under **Access requests**, with a **CRM relationship badge**
   (HubSpot/Salesforce) to assist the decision.
3. On **approve**, the network mints a **scoped, expiring** key; the requester is emailed
   the key. On **deny**, they're emailed a notice.
4. **Revoke** any key at any time - reads stop immediately and show in the audit log.

## Per-artifact access scopes

When approving, you can restrict a key to **specific artifacts** (checkboxes in the
request card). The key then reads only those documents within its scope; other artifact
fetches return `403`. Leave all unchecked for full access within scope.

## Notifications

Set a **notification email** in **Settings** and enable *"email me on every access
request."* This fires for **every** channel - web, API, and MCP - not just the web form.

## Audit log & export

Every read and management action is recorded, including which key read which artifact.
Export from the **Audit log** page as **CSV** or **JSON**, or via
`GET /v1/vendors/{id}/audit.csv`.

Want fewer manual approvals? See **[auto-release policies](/vendors/auto-release)**.
